name: Another Chance
overview: Deniz, an ambitious and level-headed investment advisor rising in the finance sector, finds himself torn between a dazzling career and love. His planned future is shattered by a car accident, and the woman he loves, Vicdan, disappears. Trapped in a triangle of memory, passion, and suspicion, Deniz searches for Vicdan while simultaneously tracing the meaning of a love that has lost its purpose.
